newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Molinos ends cheese venture with Kraft.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Molinos ends cheese venture with Kraft.

text.p: Argentine food giant Molinos is ending an alliance with the local unit of Kraft Foods because Kraft's U.S. headquarters disapproved plans to build a plant to make cheese locally, a Molinos source said Tuesday.
"We broke the agreement because they were not allowed to build the planned plant," the source told Reuters.
The agreement will end at the end of this month.
Molinos and Kraft Suchard Argentina in March formed a strategic alliance under which Kraft imported cheese from the United States and Molinos distributed it.
But then Kraft Foods, a unit of Philip Morris Cos Inc, said it was raising cheese prices about 30 percent, which made the business unattractive unless the cheese was made locally.
